name: Big Data Camp
what_you_do: A free five-day summer camp where you use real Argonne research data and tools. Scientists teach you data science, from asking good questions to making charts that show what the data means.
who_can_apply: Current high school juniors and seniors with basic coding experience in a language like Python, Java or C. You must attend all five days and get yourself to Argonne.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. Last cycle, students heard back in early May.
how_to_apply: Submit an application on the camp page when it opens. Only 30 students are picked; others go on a wait list.
notes: Questions: jdomyancich@anl.gov. The page does not give the 2027 application date, so check back in early spring.
